evidence_scope: Every fact in this report was observed on documentdb-local, i.e. the open-source DocumentDB engine and gateway at the version this container reports (hello.internal.documentdb_versions ["1.2-0", "1.2.0"]; buildInfo.version "7.0.0", which is the MongoDB compatibility version the gateway advertises, not the engine version), running as a single node that the driver sees as a mongos. It is evidence about the open-source engine and gateway at that version only; it does not prove what the managed Azure DocumentDB service does (DECISIONS.md topic 9 open item 8), and single-node results cannot show replication, failover or HA durability effects.
